about.heroTitle: Everyday life comes with a lot of small, necessary errands. We built Supermarche so you don't have to run them alone.
about.heroSubtitle: A platform connecting people across Cameroon to verified providers for the tasks that eat up a day — gas delivery, cleaning, beauty, shopping, and more.
about.storyLeft: Supermarche started with a simple observation: getting everyday help shouldn't require knowing the right person.
about.storyP1: Supermarche was born out of a real Cameroonian challenge: finding reliable, trustworthy help for home and daily errands without relying on personal contacts or guesswork.
about.storyP2: What started as a way to book a handful of services has grown into a platform covering gas delivery, back-to-school shopping, beauty and selfcare, digital security, cleaning, and market shopping.
about.storyP3: Today, Supermarche operates across major hubs in 10 regions nationwide, dispatching verified technicians and runners every day.
about.p1Desc: Every provider is verified before they can accept a job. No exceptions.
about.p2Desc: Pricing is locked in before you confirm. What you see is what you pay.
about.p3Desc: Transparent commissions and instant Mobile Money payouts ensure our service partners are valued and empowered.
about.p4Desc: Designed around how people here actually book, pay, and communicate — not a copy-paste of a foreign app.
about.ctaTitle: Want to build this with us?
about.ctaSubtitle: We're always looking for people who care about getting the details right.

pro.stepsTitle: How to Become a Supermarche Service Provider in 3 Easy Steps
pro.stepsSub: Simple registration process designed to get you verified and taking jobs fast.
pro.step1Desc: Fill out your full name, phone number, city hub (Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, Bamenda), and primary skill category.
pro.step2Desc: Our team verifies your National ID (CNI) and confirms your active Mobile Money payment details.
pro.step3Desc: Open your Supermarche Mobile Provider app, set your availability to active, and start accepting paid job tickets.

pro.faq1Q: What qualifications do I need to join as a Supermarche service pro?
pro.faq1A: You need a valid National ID (CNI) or passport, an active Mobile Money account, and demonstrated experience in your trade (gas safety, market procurement, cleaning, or repairs).
pro.faq2Q: How and when do I receive payment for completed jobs?
pro.faq2A: Payouts are transferred instantly to your MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money account as soon as the client confirms task completion and safety verification.
pro.faq3Q: Is there a registration or membership fee to join?
pro.faq3A: No, joining the Supermarche provider network is completely free. We only deduct a transparent service commission per completed job ticket.
pro.faq4Q: Which cities are currently active for provider dispatches?
pro.faq4A: Active provider dispatches are live across all major districts in Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, and Bamenda.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking, tracking, paying with Mobile Money, and safety guarantees.
faq.q1: How does gas cylinder safety inspection work during delivery?
faq.a1: Every Supermarche gas specialist carries a pressure test gauge and soapy leak test equipment. Upon delivery, the technician tests your cylinder head and regulator connection to ensure zero leak risk before departing.
faq.q2: What happens if a market item is out of stock?
faq.a2: Your purchasing lead updates your job ticket status to "Action Needed" with proposed item substitutions. You can approve or modify choices directly from your tracking dashboard.
faq.q3: Which cities and neighborhoods are currently covered in Cameroon?
faq.a3: Currently operating across all districts in Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, and Bamenda. Regional hubs expansion for Kribi and Bafoussam is slated for Q3.
